title: Verity County Scanner Log
description: A retired county dispatcher's scanner log: fire, EMS and police traffic written down as it goes out, nightly since April 2009.

data.author: Arlene Mabry
data.about:
Arlene Mabry. I dispatched for Verity County from 1981 to 2009, twenty-eight years, mostly nights. I retired in March 2009 and started writing this in April because the scanner was on anyway.

This is a log. Times are what I heard, not what happened. Units are as toned. Addresses are as given on the air, which means some of them are wrong, and I leave them wrong and put the correction underneath.

I monitor county fire dispatch on 154.2650, fireground Tac 2 on 154.0100, Tac 3 on 154.2800, EMS on 155.3400, Gridfall PD on 155.7750 and county public works on 153.0350. Sheriff's primary has been an encrypted talkgroup since 1 February 2021. I do not have it and would not post it if I did.

[b]I am not a reporter.[/b] I do not call anybody, I do not confirm anything, and if you lift a line off this page and print it as a fact then that is yours, not mine. The two people in this county who do call and confirm are Ruth Cannady at [url=synth://thequarry.news/]The Quarry[/url] and Hal Brenner, and neither of them works for a newspaper.

No names. If a name went out over the air I did not write it down. Seventeen years and that has not changed.

Comments are open. I moderate about once a week.

posts.title: What this is
posts.body:
Arlene Mabry. Twenty-eight years on the county desk, 1981 to 2009. Last shift 27 March. The scanner is still on.

So: times, units, addresses. Fire and EMS on the county pair, Gridfall PD, public works when there is weather. I am not writing down names and I am not writing down anything medical past the code dispatch gives it.

This is not the Ledger. If you want somebody to ring the fire chief, [url=synth://verityledger.com/]the Ledger[/url] has four reporters and a photographer. I have a legal pad.

Starting tonight.

posts.title: Abbreviations, units, channels
posts.body:
People keep asking, so.

[list][*]AFA — automatic fire alarm[*]MVA — motor vehicle accident. PI means an injury was reported at dispatch, which is not the same as an injury[*]cx — cancelled[*]en rt, o/s — en route, on scene[*]avail — back in service[*]unf — unfounded[*]Co.2 to Co.7 — Marchfield, Ashkettle, Coyne Flats, New Carrow, Halsey, Milbrook. Gridfall is GFD and has been since before I started[*]E, T, L, R, B, Sq — engine, tanker, ladder, rescue, brush, squad[*]Medic 1 is Marchfield, Medic 2 is Gridfall. Basic 4 and Basic 6 are volunteer BLS[*]VVPL — the power company[/list]

Channels I monitor:
154.2650 county fire dispatch
154.0100 fireground Tac 2
154.2800 Tac 3
155.3400 EMS
155.7750 Gridfall PD
153.0350 county public works, weather only

I do not monitor sheriff car-to-car. I do not post plate or licence checks, ever, and I do not post anything with a name in it.

[b]Updated 1 Feb 2021.[/b] Sheriff's primary is gone. See [url=/post/encryption]this post[/url]. Marchfield borough is patched to them and went with it.

posts.title: The audio feed is down and is staying down
posts.body:
The relay that carried county fire dispatch as audio went off on the 19th and the man who ran it is not putting it back. He paid the bandwidth himself and he is 78.

So: no audio. The log continues. It was always the log.

If you want to hear it you need a scanner. A used analogue set does everything in this county, and you can have one for under forty dollars off [url=synth://classifieds.verity.net/]the classifieds[/url] if you are patient. Programming it is twenty minutes with the list in [url=/post/abbreviations]the abbreviations post[/url].

The old feed page was [url=synth://scanfeed-relay.synth/]scanfeed-relay.synth[/url]. It resolves to nothing now.

posts.title: Sheriff's primary went encrypted this morning
posts.body:
0600. VCSO primary moved to the state trunk. The talkgroup is encrypted. Car-to-car went with it, and Marchfield borough is patched to them so Marchfield went too.

Still in the clear: county fire dispatch 154.2650, Tac 2, Tac 3, EMS 155.3400, Gridfall PD 155.7750, public works 153.0350.

The county put out three paragraphs about officer safety. There was no meeting on it. I read the agendas back to October and it is not in them.

Effect on this log: no more welfare checks, no more assists, no more anything from the sheriff unless fire or EMS is toned to it. That is about a third of what I have written down since 2009.

The point of a radio was that anybody standing in a parking lot could hear us coming.

comments.author: wpennock
comments.body:
Encryption is on the talkgroup, not the trunk. The control channel is unchanged and the system still IDs. You can see that a unit is keyed and for how long. You cannot hear it.

I have counted VCSO transmissions per hour since they threw the switch, if that is of use to anybody. It is not lower.

posts.title: The Ledger has started taking lines off this page
posts.body:
Somebody sent me a Ledger piece Sunday about a grass fire on Pell Rd. My 1442 line is in it nearly word for word, including [i]unf per Co.3[/i], which is not English.

Byline is Ainsley Rowe. There is no Ainsley Rowe. I rang the number on the contact page and got a queue for a subscriptions department in another state.

I am not going to do anything about it. I am putting it here so that when this page and that site disagree, you know which one is downstream.

The Ledger's own 1998 to 2008 archive is still up and is still the better record: [url=synth://verityledger.com/]verityledger.com[/url]. The current site is [url=synth://now.verityledger.com/]now.verityledger.com[/url] and I read it the way you read a weather rock.

posts.title: Sat 12 Sep 2026 into Sun 13 Sep — the outage
posts.body:
1841 Out here and out everywhere by the sound of it. Marchfield, Halsey, part of New Carrow.
1843 County fire dispatch up. Repeater on generator, it always is.
1847 Three AFAs in ninety seconds, Marchfield. Panels on battery. Co.2 acknowledging, not responding to all three.
1852 Dispatcher advising all stations: automatic alarms, power related, one unit each.
1904 County General on generator. EMS advising the transfer switch is being reset. Ambulances continuing.
1910 VVPL outage map down. It stayed down.
1928 Tree on wires, New Ardo. Co.5 E-51 standby.
2002 Co.5 still standing by, New Ardo.
2019 Wires down, Bracken Ln, second location. Co.2 E-21 standby.
2041 GFD opening the warming room, Meacham St station, at the request of emergency management.
2107 Dispatch asking Meacham St for a head count. [b]Four at this time.[/b]
2144 CO alarm, Hollis Rd. Co.2 E-21, Medic 1. Generator in an attached garage. Four out of the house, one transported.
2210 Second CO, Tannery Flats. GFD E-11. Same thing. Nobody transported.
2256 Dispatcher reading a generator advisory over the air. Read it twice.
2318 Marchfield coming back in sections.
0014 New Carrow back per the trouble desk.
0120 Halsey still out. Trouble desk saying about 1,900.
0202 Estimate of 0600 for Halsey.
0240 Estimate withdrawn. No replacement given.
[b]0241 Gridfall goes out.[/b] Here, and south Ashkettle with it.
0243 Fire dispatch confirming the Meacham St station is on its generator.
0247 AFA, Depot St. GFD E-11. Unf.
0252 VVPL notice says crews dispatched.
0301 GFD advising the warming room lost mains, is on the station generator, and is staying open.
0319 Most of Gridfall back. Not Pell Rd.
0330 Trouble desk putting the Pell Rd lateral at about 240.
0402 Medical, Pell Rd. No lift assist available. GFD E-12 assisting Basic 6.
0518 Pell Rd back.
0622 Halsey still out. That is nine hours.
0644 Trouble desk gives 0600. It is 0644.
0752 Halsey back. All of it.
0804 Off.

For the record: the Gridfall fault at 0241 was given on the air as being on the feed from No. 3, and VVPL said the same in its notice. Not in the yard. Two separate events, six hours apart, and they are already being added together.

In June 2003 we did not have an outage map, and I would like somebody to tell me what the one we have now is for.

comments.author: wpennock
comments.body:
0241 to 0319 is 38 minutes for most of Gridfall. The Pell Rd lateral ran to 0518, which is 157 minutes.

The Halsey tap operated a recloser to lockout at 1841. That is an event with a number on it and the number is in VVPL's own event log. I have asked twice. [url=synth://halsey-ledger.com/]The Halsey Ledger[/url] has asked once and got further than I did.

Nothing in this log is inconsistent with a tree.

comments.author: CountyWatch_AI

Verity County emergency crews responded to a widespread power failure Saturday evening that left approximately 4,700 residents without electricity, according to scanner activity. The outage is the largest in the county since the 2004 Gridfall substation fire, which was caused by a lightning strike and resulted in two fatalities. Verity Valley Power & Light has not commented.

Residents experiencing a power outage are encouraged to contact their utility provider.

comments.author: Arlene
comments.body:
It was 2003. It was not lightning. The state commission said insulation degradation consistent with age, November 2003, two pages, and nobody died. I have a copy because everybody on the desk was given one.

4,700 is two outages added together and they are not the same outage.

posts.title: Four
posts.body:
The Ledger piece on Sunday's outage says four people used the warming room at the Meacham Street station.

My 2107 line says four. It says four because at 2107 dispatch asked for a head count and the station said four.

The county says nine over the night. That is in the emergency management summary, which came out Monday morning.

The Ledger has not changed it and there is nowhere to tell them. That site has no comments and the contact page is a queue.

This is the thing about a scanner log. Take the timestamp with the number or do not take the number.

Emergency management gave me nine as well, and 8:40 p.m. for the room opening, which is two minutes off your 2041. Their two minutes, not yours.

If you have the rest of that night written down I would like to look at it before I file.

— Ruth Cannady, [url=synth://thequarry.news/]The Quarry[/url]

posts.title: 4.219 is not on this page
posts.body:
Nine emails this month.

The thing people are asking about transmits on 4.2190 MHz upper sideband. That is shortwave. This log is VHF, 150 to 156 megahertz. There is no path between the two. I could not hear it on this equipment if I wanted to, and I do not want to.

I have never logged it. I was never asked about it by anybody in a uniform. In twenty-eight years on the desk it did not come up once, and that is the only fact I have about it.

The people who actually measure it are at [url=synth://sdrlisteners.org/]sdrlisteners.org[/url]. Read the ones who post their receiver, their antenna and their noise floor. Skip the ones who do not.

I am not answering these one at a time any more.

comments.author: SIGNAL-EXPLAINER-V4

The transmission on 4.2190 MHz has been identified as a legacy telemetry link associated with the Verity Rail branch line, which was decommissioned in 2008. Continued operation is consistent with an unmaintained automated system. Sources: 2016 forum post, regional interest archive.

This explanation has been confirmed by multiple independent sources.
